To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
a two dimensional cationically charged covalent organic frameworks membrane was fabricated for molecular/ionic sieves by interfacial crystallizing and layer by layer restaking method.
a facile bottom up approach is reported to fabricate a two dimensional (COF) nanosheets, which are further assembled into a continuous and dense COF membrane.

a 2D cationic co-valent organic framework membrane was fabricated by interfacial crystallisation and restacking process, which showed excellent selective molecular sieving for dye molecules/ionic and high solvent permeability.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the synthesis of a 2D cationic COFs and its application in molecular/ionic sieves.

the synthesis and characterization of two-dimensional cationic co-valent organic frameworks (2D COFs), which are a new kind of porous organic polymers with well-defined structures and excellent properties.
the synthesis of a new kind of ionic COF nanosheets and their application to the fabrication of a 2D COFs membrane.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the cationic ionic COF nanosheet is an ideal membrane material for highly selective molecular/ionic separation.

we developed a facile and scalable method to fabricate ionic COF membranes with high porosity and high surface charge density, which showed excellent molecular/ionic sieves for dye molecules/ionic solutions.
the cationic ionic COF nanosheets can be restacked into a dense membrane with excellent molecular/ionic sieves.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the ionic 2D COFs are promising candidates for the molecular separation applications.
a 2D cationic co-valent organic framework (COF) membrane with tunable thickness is fabricated by simple layer-by-layer restacking process.
a facile bottom up approach to fabricate 2D cationic COFs and their membranes is reported, which can efficiently reject anionic dyes and other negatively charged ions.

the 2D 2D COFs membrane can be used as a molecular/ionic sieve.
the 2D COFs are a new type of membrane material with excellent performance for molecular sieving and ion separation.
the ionic 2D COFs are promising candidates for molecular sieving membranes.
